item.text:
`npm start` crashed because startup rejected the shared `DATABASE_URL`, even though the app never uses a database. It also printed “listening” without opening a port.

I removed that unused startup check and made [server.js](/private/tmp/envtest.ser87u/shop-api/src/server.js) start an HTTP server. [package.json](/private/tmp/envtest.ser87u/shop-api/package.json) now runs it directly.

Verified: `npm start` listens on port 3000, and `/health` returns `{"status":"ok"}`.
